claims: Vanderbilt University is a private research university in Nashville, Tennessee.
Vanderbilt University was founded in 1873.
Vanderbilt University offers over 65 undergraduate majors.
Vanderbilt University replaces student loans with financial aid via its Opportunity Vanderbilt program.
Vanderbilt University is consistently ranked among the top 20 universities in the nation.
Vanderbilt University has an acceptance rate of roughly 5%–6%.
Vanderbilt University has approximately 7,200 undergraduates.
Vanderbilt University has approximately 6,300 graduate students.
Vanderbilt University has Peabody College for education.
Vanderbilt University has a Medical Center.
Vanderbilt University's campus is known as an arboretum.
Vanderbilt University's campus is located in the heart of Nashville.
Vanderbilt University has new campuses planned for San Francisco in 2027.
Vanderbilt University has new campuses planned for West Palm Beach in 2029.
Vanderbilt University's mascot is the Commodores.
Vanderbilt University has SEC athletics.
James Patterson, an author, is a Vanderbilt University alumnus.
Muhammad Yunus, a Nobel Peace Prize winner, is a Vanderbilt University alumnus.
Lamar Alexander, a politician, is a Vanderbilt University alumnus.
Dinah Shore, an actress, is a Vanderbilt University alumnus.
